original.question: When Sophie dey watch her nephew, she dey bring out different play things for him. The bag of building blocks get 31 blocks inside. The bin of stuffed animals get 8 stuffed animals inside. The tower of stacking rings get 9 different color rings on it. Sophie just buy tube of bouncy balls, make her total number of toys for her nephew reach 62. How many bouncy balls come inside the tube?
original.answer:
Let T be number of bouncy balls inside the tube.
After buy the tube of balls, Sophie get 31 + 8 + 9 + T = 48 + T = 62 toys for her nephew.
So, T = 62 - 48 = <<62-48=14>>14 bouncy balls come inside the tube.
